common_actions.description: Click Load demo export to render the dashboard demo payload.
Click any node card to recompute upstream and downstream traces from that node.
Use the search box to filter visible nodes and edges by text.
Use the group dropdown to isolate evidence, device, error, calibration, score, or architecture nodes.
Use the edge-type dropdown to isolate supports, measured_on, mitigated_by, derived_from, feeds_module, or updates edges.
Click Export focused trace to save a JSON file containing only the current trace nodes, edges, and boundary cards.
